lines.speaker: old_maud
lines.text: The boy is by my fire. Let his father know. As for that old bear… hunger wakes before a creature does. Go gently, if you can.
lines.direction: Ancient, papery, unhurried; lucid concern under the cackle. No grand revelation.

lines.speaker: old_maud
lines.text: Poor old thing. A hundred winters, and the last was the coldest. No, dearie. Keep the claw. There is nothing else down there to carry home.
lines.direction: Ancient, papery, unhurried; a small grief, without explaining its cause.
